Class CssStyleResolver

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.css.cascade.CssStyleResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
StylePropertyResolver
public final class CssStyleResolver extends Object implements StylePropertyResolver
Represents the computed style for an element after CSS cascade resolution.

Implements StylePropertyResolver to allow typed property access using PropertyDefinitions. Properties can be retrieved either through the typed getters (e.g., foreground()) or through the generic get(PropertyDefinition) method.

Example usage with PropertyDefinition: 

CssStyleResolver style = cascadeResolver.resolve(element, rules);
Color borderColor = style.get(StandardProperties.BORDER_COLOR).orElse(Color.WHITE);

    • get

      public <T> Optional<T> get(PropertyDefinition<T> property)
      Retrieves a typed property value using the given property definition.

      The resolution order is:

      1. Check for a pre-converted value in the typed property map
      2. Check for a raw CSS value and convert using the property's converter
      This allows widget-defined properties to be resolved from CSS without requiring the CSS engine to know about all properties upfront.
      Specified by:
      get in interface StylePropertyResolver
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the property value
      Parameters:
      property - the property definition
      Returns:
      the property value, or empty if not found

    • withFallback

      public CssStyleResolver withFallback(CssStyleResolver fallback)
      Creates a new resolver that uses this resolver's properties but falls back to the given resolver for CSS-inheritable properties not set in this resolver.

      Per CSS semantics, only certain properties inherit from parent to child. The inheritance behavior is defined per-property in PropertyDefinition.isInheritable().

      Additionally, this method handles the inherit keyword: properties explicitly requesting parent's value.

      Parameters:
      fallback - the fallback resolver for missing inheritable properties
      Returns:
      a new resolver with fallback behavior for inheritable properties only
